artifacts.summary: Verdict: a doubled (two one-sided, clock-anchored) automaton is sufficient in shape and no bi-infinite Z-automaton is needed, conditional on separation at ZTime; but the one-sidedness mismatch is NOT the binding obstruction. The binding obstruction is the AA carrier, and it is proved intrinsic here (unique-predecessor + TwoWayBounded + surjectivity forces a past-deterministic base), so coneR's two-layer shape is forced and its Saturation obligation unavoidable. A layer-split route to that obligation is given, whose one missing ingredient -- oriented-forest Saturation -- is also the MSO cover step's prerequisite. Report 03 section 1.3's ZTime reading is corrected: existence of a recursive axiomatization is still open, not only naturalness. Two defects of record found in the landed LC material.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 865 to close out research. Four follow-ons are proposed in the report: R1 oriented-forest Saturation (lean4, highest value, unblocks two fronts), R2 fix the LCU record and restore omega_chain's segment-property parameter plus the one-line backward LC_n corollary (lean4, corrective), R3 the doubled AA-boxdot rule (gated on R1 and on separation at ZTime), R5 amend report 03 section 1.3's closing sentence. R4 (MSO formalization) is explicitly not to be filed.
